## Description

What does this PR do? (e.g. fix a controller bug, add a webhook check, update CRD, improve Helm chart)

## Related issue

Fixes #(issue number) — or "None"

## How to verify

- [ ] Steps to test (e.g. install operator with Helm, apply persona and deployment, check status)
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make lint` passes (or no new lint issues)
- [ ] If API/types were changed: `make manifests generate` was run and generated files are committed

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project style
- [ ] Tests added or updated where appropriate
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed (README, CONTRIBUTING, or code comments)
